question.text:
Smartphone A has 256 MB RAM and 32 GB ROM with an 8 MP camera. Smartphone B has 288 MB RAM and 64 GB ROM with a 4 MP camera. Smartphone C has 128 MB RAM and 32 GB ROM with a 5 MP camera.

What is the truth value of the proposition: "Smartphone A has more RAM than Smartphone B if and only if Smartphone B has more RAM than Smartphone A"?

  1. TRUE, because both sides of the biconditional are FALSE.
  2. TRUE, because both sides of the biconditional are TRUE.
  3. FALSE, because the left side is FALSE and the right side is TRUE.
  4. FALSE, because both sides of the biconditional are FALSE.
question.subject: Mathematical Logic

question.text:
During the most recent fiscal year, Acme Computer had an annual revenue of \$138 billion and a net profit of \$8 billion, Nadir Software had an annual revenue of \$87 billion and a net profit of \$5 billion, and Quixote Media had an annual revenue of \$111 billion and a net profit of \$13 billion.

What is the truth value of the proposition: "Nadir Software had the smallest net profit if and only if Acme Computer had the largest annual revenue"?

 

  1. FALSE, because Nadir Software did not have the smallest net profit.
  2. FALSE, because both sides of the biconditional are FALSE.
  3. TRUE, because both sides of the biconditional are TRUE.
  4. TRUE, because both sides of the biconditional are FALSE.
question.subject: Mathematical Logic

question.text:
Given: Smartphone A (256 MB RAM, 32 GB ROM, 8 MP), Smartphone B (288 MB RAM, 64 GB ROM, 4 MP ), Smartphone C ( 128 MB RAM, 32 GB ROM, 5 MP ). Which of the following propositions are TRUE? Select all that apply.

  1. Smartphone B has the most RAM of the three smartphones.
  2. Smartphone C has more ROM or a higher resolution camera than Smartphone B .
  3. Smartphone B has more RAM, more ROM, and a higher resolution camera than Smartphone A.
  4. If Smartphone B has more RAM and more ROM than Smartphone C, then it also has a higher resolution camera than Smartphone C.
question.subject: Mathematical Logic

question.text:
Given: Acme Computer (revenue \$138B, profit \$8B), Nadir Software (revenue \$87B, profit \$5B), Quixote Media (revenue \$111B, profit \$13B). Which of the following propositions are TRUE? Select all that apply.

  1. Quixote Media had the largest annual revenue.
  2. Nadir Software had the lowest net profit and Acme Computer had the largest annual revenue.
  3. Acme Computer had the largest net profit or Quixote Media had the largest net profit.
  4. If Quixote Media had the smallest net profit, then Acme Computer had the largest annual revenue.
question.subject: Mathematical Logic

question.text:
Let $\mathrm{S}=$ "I study for this exam", $\mathrm{A}=$ "I attend class", $\mathrm{P}=$ "I pass the class." The statement "If I study for this exam and attend class, then I will pass the class" is expressed as $(\mathrm{S} \wedge \mathrm{A}) \rightarrow \mathrm{P}$. Which of the following are logically equivalent to this statement? Select all that apply.

  1. If I pass the class, then I studied for this exam and attended class.
  2. If I do not pass the class, then I did not study for this exam and did not attend class.
  3. If I do not pass the class, then I did not study for this exam or did not attend class.
  4. $\neg \mathrm{S} \vee \neg \mathrm{A} \vee \mathrm{P}$
question.subject: Mathematical Logic
